paite: Huan Leah tanu Dinah, Jakob nesak, hai gaunate mu ding in apawtkhia hi.
heading: Dinah Sualluihna
english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

paite: Hiv mi Hamor, huai gam vaihawmpa tapa Shekem in amah ana mu a, pummat in aluppih a, ahihninta hi.
english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

paite: Jakob tanu Dinah tung ah alungsim a- omden a, huai nungak a-it mahmah a, kamsiamtak in ahoupih hi.
english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

paite: Shekem in apa Hamor ahoupih a, "Ka zi ding in huai nungak hon pisak in," achi hi.
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

paite: Jakob in atanu Dinah aninsak khin chih aza a, gamlak ah aganhonte lak uah atapate a-om uhi. Huchi in ahong tun mateng uh Jakob adai dide hi.
english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

paite: Jakob houpih ding in Shekem pa Hamor akiang ah ahoh hi.
english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

paite: Jakob tapate'n azaktak un gamlak a kipan ahong pai ua, Jakob tanu kithuahpih in Israelte lak a thil gilou haihuaitak, thilhih het louh ding, ahih ziak in adah ua, aheh mahmah uhi.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

paite: Hamor in amau ahoupih a, "Ka tapa Shekem lungsim na tanu uh tung ah a-om tinten a, hehpih in azi ding in neisak ve ua.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

paite: Kilatuah ve ni e; na tanute uh hon lasak unla, ka tanute uh leng la sam un.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

paite: "Ka kiang uah na teng ding ua; gam leng akiching gige ding. Hiai ah teng unla, sum sin unla, hiai ah kihih inbul un," achi hi.
english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

paite: Shekem in nungak' pa leh asanggampate kiang ah, "Na deihsakna uh hon musak unla, huan ka kiang a na gen peuh uh ka hon pe ding.
english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

paite: Man leh thilpiak zaw bangzah gen le uchin, na chih bangbang uh ka hon pe ding. Akoi abang hitaleh, nungak pen zi ding in hon neisak phot un," achi hi.
english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

paite: Jakob tapate'n asanggamnu uh Dinah anitsak ziak in Shekem leh apa Hamor khembawl in adawng ua, akiang uah,
english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

paite: "Hiai thil zeksum louh mi kiang a ka tanu uh piak pen ka hihthei kei ding uh; huai lah koute a ding in minsiatna ahi ngal a.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

paite: Hichibang a kichiam kia in na thu uh pha ka sa ding uh. Na lak ua pasal peuhpeuh koute bang a zeksum in om uhen.
english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

paite: Huchi in ka tanute uh na nei ding ua, kou leng na tanute uh ka nei sam ding uh. Na kiang uah ka teng ding ua, chi khat i hi ding.
english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

paite: Himahleh, zeksum thu a ka thu uh na zuih kei ding uleh, ka tanu uh ka pi ding ua, ka pai mai ding uh," achi uhi.
english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

paite: Athugen un Hamor leh Hamor tapa Shekem akipaksak hi.
english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

paite: Tangval in Jakob tanu adeih mahmah ziak in huai thil sawt hal lou in ahihta hi. Amah apa inkuan tengteng lak a mite zahtak pen ahi.
english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

paite: Hamor leh atapa Shekem in akhokulh kongkhak uh apha ua, akhote uh ahoupih uhi.
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

paite: "Hiai mite ei toh kilemtak in a-om uh. Huaiziak in hiai gam a teng in, hiai ah sum sin uhen. Ngai un, amaute a ding in gam lah aza ngal a. Atanute uh zi in nei lehang, i tanute uh leng neisak sam ni.
english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

paite: Himahleh nam khat i hong hihna ding a i kiang a tentheihna ding un hichibang a i chiam kia in huai mite'n pha ahon sakpih ding uhi; zeksum ahih bang ua i lak ua pasal peuhpeuh zeksum hong hita lehang.
english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

paite: Agante uh, asumte uh, asa tengteng uh ei a ahi vek kei dia hia? Athu uh pha sakpih mai ve ni e, huchi in i kiang uah ateng ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

paite: Hamor leh atapa Shekem thu a khokulh kongkhak a pawtkhe tengteng in azui ua; akhokulh kongkhak a pawtkhe tengteng, pasal peuhpeuh zek asumsak uhi.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani thum ni a, nat athuak lai un, Jakob tapate lak a nih, Dinah sanggampa Simeon leh Levi in anamsau uh tawi tuak in aguk in khua ava sualta ua, pasal tengteng athatgam uhi.
english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

paite: Namsau hiam in Hamor leh atapa Shekem athat ua, Shekem inn a kipan Dinah api ua, apawtta uhi.
english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

paite: Jakob tapate'n amithahte uh ava pha nawn ua, atanu uh anitsak ziak un huai khua alokta uhi.
english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

paite: Abelamhonte uh, abawnghonte uh, asabiltungte uh, akhua ua thil omte leh alou ua thil omte alaksak uhi.
english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

paite: Asum tengteng uleh ata-anau neu chikchikte leh azite tengteng uh sal in aman ua, insung a om tengteng alok uhi.
english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

paite: Jakob in Simeon leh Levi kiang ah, "Nou hiai gam a tengte lak a, Kanaante leh Perizte lak ah, huat na hon posak ua, na hon lungzingsak mahmah uh. Kei tawmchik ka hih ziak in hon sual ding in akikhawmkhawm ding ua, ahon that mai ding uhi. Huchi in hihmang in ka om ding, kei leh ka inkuanpihte toh,” achi hi.
english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

paite: Amau, "Ka sanggamnu uh kizuak bang a abawl ding ahi a hia?" achi uhi.
english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”
